description: Detects and redacts PII/PHI/PCI (SSNs, credit cards, IBANs, UK NHS numbers, emails, phone numbers, IPs) in text before it is logged, sent to a third party, or persisted. Uses deterministic checksum validation (Luhn, ISO-7064, mod-11). Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK, a redacted copy of the text, and a signed certificate. Call this before any egress of user or record data.

blockSeverityAtOrAbove.description: Minimum severity that yields BLOCK (default: high).

mode.description: 'block' returns the raw verdict (default). 'flag' downgrades BLOCK to FLAG. 'audit' never blocks (log-only).

redact.description: Return a redacted copy of the text (default: true).

text.description: The text to scan for personal data.

name: scan_pii
